title: Wednesday 25 November round-up
text:
Good morning, it is Wednesday 25 November: this is the GERICO round-up.

Let's start with Yemen. The Saudi-led coalition says it has struck the Houthi-controlled port of Hodeidah, while the Houthis threaten to strike Jeddah and other Saudi ports on the Red Sea.

Iran has ordered the Strait of Hormuz to be kept closed, while Qatar is working to bring the United States and Iran back to the negotiating table.

In Ukraine, Putin has said that retaliation for the attacks on oil refineries is inevitable. Overnight, fresh Ukrainian drones reportedly struck two refineries in the Samara region.

In the United States, a New York jury has found Huawei guilty of trade secret theft and bank fraud. The company will appeal.

Moving on to the markets. Yesterday Wall Street closed mixed: the Dow Jones rose by 0.86%, while the Nasdaq lost around 1.5%. Nvidia fell by 7.4% and the slide in tech stocks reached Asia, where SoftBank lost 15%. Piazza Affari closed down by 1.84% and the BTP-Bund spread stands at 109 points.

Today at 14:30, in the United States, third-quarter gross domestic product and the PCE price index are released. At 20:00, the Federal Reserve's Beige Book.

The full stories, complete with sources, are on GERICO. No investment advice.
